item.title: Flyyipping waste of construction waste and house appliances being dump, 21st September
item.description:

Again we last Sunday of September 20,2026 we heard a noice throwing sound at the backdoor and same construction waste was dumped on the same area. It will cause risk of falls and break to our fence,environmental problem for pest and complete obstruction of footpath for people and small pets dog that we have. We are deeply bothered and concern they will continue to dump because of their home projects.

item.description:

item.title: Tree tie needs loosening on Rowan tree opp 55 Barnmead Rd Beckenham at the jct with Kent House Rd., 20th September
item.description:
Tree tie needs loosening on Rowan tree opp 55 Barnmead Rd Beckenham at the jct with Kent House Rd. The tree ties look like rubber but they are inextensible and over a hundred saplings have been mutilated by this method of fixing in Bromley Borough. If this is the responsibility of the unadopted road owners, please liaise with Barnmead Rd Residents Ltd. I do not live in this road but I was alarmed to see it while passing on foot. Conservation Area (Article 4). The sapling diameter is the same as the tree stake, so perhaps the stake and strangling tree tie can now be removed altogether.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Barnmead Road, Penge, Greater London

item.title: Chronic fly tipping, 20th September
item.description:
The fly tipping in the swan mead area is chronic and constant. there is both constant fly tipping and overflowing waste bins. Clearly, on the side of the street, someone has just cleared out a house and dumbed all the belongings there without even bothering to put many of the clothes into bags. its disguishing. The refuse chutes have also overflown, i assume because the same person has dumped a lot of waste into the chutes. this is presumably a landlord or someone clearing out an abaonded house with belongings still in them. its unacceptable and CCTV must be installed to stop this behaviour. every few weeks there is major cases of fly tipping here

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Leroy Street, Walworth, Greater London
